question: Around which year (in BC) did Chandragupta Maurya establish the Maurya Empire?
solution:
The correct answer is __**321 BC**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• **Chandragupta Maurya** established the **Maurya Empire** around **321 BC** after overthrowing the Nanda Dynasty in Magadha (modern-day Bihar).

• He was the founder of the first significant centralized empire in ancient India and ruled with the guidance of his mentor and advisor, **Chanakya (Kautilya)**, the author of the Arthashastra.

• Chandragupta's reign marked the beginning of a new political era in Indian history, characterized by a unified and centralized administration.

• The Maurya Empire under Chandragupta expanded across a vast territory, encompassing northern and central India and parts of present-day Afghanistan and Pakistan.
